labels.name: question
labels.rationale: Reporter found the cause: output was piped through tee, so Rich correctly treated it as non-terminal. Intended behaviour, documented in console.rst.

items.body:
Thanks for following up with the cause. This is intended behaviour: when Rich detects that output is not a terminal, it strips control codes, so live updates like `track()` print plain output instead of redrawing in place. The docs describe this in [console.rst](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/console.rst). If you need control codes written to a file or pipe, set `force_terminal=True` on the `Console` constructor.

Related: #2326

For questions like this, [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) is the right place.
